recommendations.title: Optimize Largest Contentful Paint (LCP)

recommendations.technicalReason: Metric "performance.coreWebVitals.lcp" evaluated to 19477.03, failing target threshold (<= 2500).
recommendations.expectedBenefit: Instant visual content rendering for arriving visitors, improving conversion rate.

Add rel="preload" link header for the critical LCP image resource

recommendations.title: Reduce Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS)
recommendations.summary: Eliminate visual layout instability below the 0.10 threshold.
recommendations.technicalReason: Metric "performance.coreWebVitals.cls" evaluated to 1.1341, failing target threshold (<= 0.1).
recommendations.expectedBenefit: Stable visual experience preventing accidental clicks and user frustration.
implementationHints: Set explicit width and height attributes on all img and video elements
Reserve layout dimension containers for dynamic ad or banner slots

recommendations.title: Improve Interaction to Next Paint (INP)
